address: 10/3 Soi Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok, 10110, Thailand
bio: Depending on your appetite, choose between a small or large portion of clear minced pork soup and perfectly flavoured tom yum broth. Each steaming bowl is topped with homemade fish balls and, if you so fancy, crispy fish skin. The minced pork balls are also a highlight....
